item.title: iPhone 18 Pro, Max & Duo Colors Leaked Before Event
item.description: Mark Gurman leaks iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max and the first foldable iPhone Duo color options, fueling excitement before Apple’s 10 a.m. PT event.

item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: Specs & Impact
item.description: Apple's iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max launch with 6.3‑ and 6.9‑inch displays, A20 Pro chip, up to 30‑hour battery, 48 MP camera, and a 2 TB storage option.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro $1,199 Base, 2 TB Option, Why Prices Jump
item.description: Apple unveils iPhone 18 Pro at $1,199 and Pro Max at $1,299, adds a 2 TB storage tier, and cites a $100 price rise amid global memory shortages.

item.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro & Duo Price Hike to $1,199 – Impact
item.description: Apple unveils the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max at a new $1,199 starting price, while the foldable iPhone Duo enters the market amid modest price hikes.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro & Pro Max: Specs, Pricing & Impact
item.description: Apple unveils the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max with the new A20 Pro chip, longer battery life, new colors, and higher prices starting at $1,199.

item.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Event: Dates, Rumors & Impact
item.description: Apple will send invites for its September 9 iPhone event, the iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max, a foldable iPhone Ultra, Watch Series 12, and new AirPods 5.

item.title: iOS 27 Beta 5 Reveals Six Unreleased iPhone 18 Models
item.description: iOS 27 beta 5’s system files expose hidden IDs for six upcoming iPhone 18 models, suggesting a split‑launch and new battery‑intelligence code.

item.title: Apple September iPhone Event: Split Launch, Price Hikes
item.description: Apple's September iPhone showcase will debut a split iPhone 18 lineup, price‑jumping Pro models, Siri‑AI devices, camera‑enabled AirPods, and more.

item.title: iPhone 18 Pro Price Hike: $250‑$300 Rise Explained
item.description: Analyst Jeff Pu predicts a $250‑$300 price hike for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max, blaming 2nm silicon and memory cost spikes, and warns of demand uncertainty.

item.title: Apple Pushes for 20% OLED Price Cut in iPhone 18 Pro Max
item.description: Apple negotiates a steep 20% OLED panel price cut for iPhone 18 Pro Max to offset rising memory costs, targeting $66.50 per panel.
